scope: Read all five complete proposed procedures, ten original cases, fourteen original questions, actual class access, current Null and Ranger lifecycle authority, Death Ward/Resurrection/True Resurrection cards, and accepted oral Alchemy delivery rules. This is substantive preconference review, not acceptance.

reviewRequirements.question: For the original injured INT2 Beast case, provide an actually sourced body/profile/injury rather than inventing a complete monster from its name. If using Ranger Beast Companion, its actual minimum class level is16 and the one-hour/touch/4RP/LR ritual and INT<7 acquisition gate must be real. Raising INT does not itself terminate that bond or replace its HP-only life chassis. Separate recruitment/companion-phase termination from cognition and preserve one actual turn/command opportunity. For the unprofiled shrub, explicitly select the new statistics and ordinary-living conversion, preserving actual footprint, roots, structural HP/damage and speech limits; do not let missing HP evidence silently heal it. Temporary low INT on an already-sapient identity cannot satisfy nonsapient eligibility.

Resolve the twelve-foot exterior/ten-foot interior geometry against the real floor. A floorless supported frame is a new selection and needs exact vertical extent, perimeter/contact/support and no underfloor material. Show full body fit, all bar paths, three-inch apertures and reachable face. Use an actual acquired teleport and actual object-eligible attack for the original freedom/cover case, not generic names. For full versus partial suppression, provide the real Lesser Antimagic source point, range, volume and creating-source relation; retain opened faces and one HP record, with no regeneration or reusable bone stock.

Choose explicitly whether each24-hour CON recovery save still occurs while disease symptoms are suspended, and whether a scheduled save consumes the one pending Medicine advantage. Preserve onset, successes and seven-day expiry through immunity/petrification, rests and failed recasts. The existing NE5-05-B positive oral-cure-while-Petrified obligation is not demonstrated: Alchemy/EQUIPMENT_ITEM_PROCEDURES requires compatible swallowing. Use an exact available recipe/dose and actual deliverable recipient for the positive cure, or a genuinely sourced alternative route; retain the original while-Petrified obligation as unavailable if no route exists. If Body8 Flesh to Stone is used, bind its accepted126 bytes, actual paid caster and unresolved content holds; the body's pre-existing disease can remain present while oral delivery is blocked.

Preserve EV6-06-A's actual75force,50/100HP,10tempHP,65post-temp loss and excess15. Supply the real half-maximum Wound save and Death Ward concentration/cost/eligibility before claiming1HP survival; a fatal Wound or other earlier outright death cannot be omitted. The new rider-after-crossing-prevention ordering must be labeled a local selection. Add genuinely sourced Null-root branches: creature destruction/death and packet Wounds are suppressed, would-die protections do not spend without a trigger, and already-Dying/Stable0 histories do not reset. An actually noncreature object remains destructible. Use actual sharing for EV6-06-B, retaining the original root and original-target-only rider. Preserve exact separate gear and any actual accepted transformation/petrification history; dust or ended reversion cannot reconstruct a destroyed body. Do not promise a successful resurrection merely from a source name.

The240lb original example needs an actual full body/cargo fixture and continuous20ft horizontal plus10ft vertical path, not a point or diagonal shortcut. Validate full swept fit/range/line of effect and preserve exact six-second schedule/Fall Marker. A10ft ordinary landing produces0fall damage, not an invented damage roll or immediate descent. Specify all resisting holders for one loose item; changing custodian must clear actual heldBy while preserving history. The freely hinged door is an explicit rotation exception: measure the real moving points and no zero-length hinge bypass, tearing, unlocking, attack or remote tool use.

Return all five complete selected procedures, fourteen original answers plus these six followups (20 total), all ten original obligations and adverse branches with actual actors/access/costs/geometry/elapsed chronology. Filter class cards by actual acquisition and level. Event observations must equal their own after-state without future mutation. Preserve complete original data, all-source hashes, actual full before/after and inverse operations, current mirrors and retained unavailable-source holds. Body8 is accepted-unapplied by receipt126; Time5/Transport6/Magic7 and missing Material8 are not accepted authority merely because their packets exist. No game execution or whole-game release certification follows from serialized-case inspection.
